risk-1.text: [important, needs-a-human] `scripts/new-wiki.py:510-514` (and `:911-916`), `scripts/wiki-upgrade.py:68-69` — a global refresh whose toolset write or remove failed still exits 0. Quotes: `_print_tooling_summary(summary)` / `if summary.get("frontmatter_failed"):` … `return 0`; wiki-upgrade: `print_summary(summary)` / `return 0`. `status["failed"] = failed` (`_install_tooling.py:257`) is only printed (`:1394-1397`). Before: `(root / rel).unlink()` raised, `install_tooling` wrapped it in `InstallIncomplete` (`_install_tooling.py:647-650`), and both entry points returned 1 (`wiki-upgrade.py:62-64`, `new-wiki.py:504-506`). CHANGELOG line 35 says the refresh "exits 1"; true only for `--phase docs` (`new-wiki.py:815-817`). Path: `install-wiki.ps1:172-186` (no `-TargetFolder` runs tooling), `:211-215` `exit $LASTEXITCODE`. Blast radius: the remove loop runs after the add loop regardless (`_install_tooling.py:251-256`). If the new path alone cannot be written (the case `test_write_failure_is_listed_failed_rest_refreshed` builds), the spec exists nowhere; `wiki-update.py:1280-1281` prints `tier rubric: not found` and ingest goes on choosing tiers; the fallback at `wiki-update.py:1265` resolves to `~/.claude/framework-docs/` because `CC_GLOBAL_WIKI_SCRIPTS_DIR = CC_GLOBAL_DIR / "wiki-scripts"` (`_install_tooling.py:32`) and no install creates it. Phase B's `--install-global-if-missing` (`new-wiki.py:903-914`) then scaffolds anyway. Mitigation: `toolset_status` recomputes from disk, so `--mode status` reports stale. Fix: return 1 from both tooling paths when `summary["toolset"].get("failed")`, as `frontmatter_failed` already does, or make the CHANGELOG promise true for this path.
